sec.title: Hackers Hijack Hotel Wi-Fi to Steal Microsoft 365 Credentials
sec.brief: S. S. 20 patches multiple security issues, including a critical command injection bug ReliaQuest’s threat research team just documented attackers compromising the Wi-Fi gateways at hotels and conference centers, then quietly rerouting guests toward fake Microsoft login pages. No phishing email required. No malicious attachment. Just bad luck about which hotel you picked. ” reads the report published by ReliaQuest. ”
